gaps.sentence: The new ___ (GOVERN) takes office in May.
He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.

gaps.sentence: The economy showed further ___ (WEAK) in the third quarter.
gaps.explanation: 'Further weakness' — the noun form follows the adjective 'further'.

gaps.sentence: The storm caused ___ (WIDE) damage along the coast.
gaps.explanation: 'Widespread damage' = damage across a large area.

gaps.sentence: Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.
'Applause' is the noun; 'applaud' is the verb.

gaps.sentence: The instructions have been ___ (SIMPLE) so that children can follow them.
gaps.explanation: Passive 'have been simplified' — the verb form meaning made simpler.
